import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import time
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Setup directories
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from correct paths
print("Loading data...")
start_time = time.time()
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
print(f"Loaded {len(train_df)} training rows and {len(test_df)} test rows")

print(f"Train columns: {train_df.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Test columns: {test_df.columns.tolist()}")


# Feature engineering function
def engineer_features(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Parse datetime
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"], utc=True)

    # Time features
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.day
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["dayofweek"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year

    # Calculate Haversine distance approximation
    df["latitude_diff"] = df["pickup_latitude"] - df["dropoff_latitude"]
    df["longitude_diff"] = df["pickup_longitude"] - df["dropoff_longitude"]
    df["distance"] = np.sqrt((df["latitude_diff"]) ** 2 + (df["longitude_diff"]) ** 2)
    df["distance"] = df["distance"].clip(0.1, 1000)

    # Fill NaN coordinates with NYC defaults
    df["pickup_latitude"] = df["pickup_latitude"].fillna(40.7128)
    df["pickup_longitude"] = df["pickup_longitude"].fillna(-74.0060)
    df["dropoff_latitude"] = df["dropoff_latitude"].fillna(40.7128)
    df["dropoff_longitude"] = df["dropoff_longitude"].fillna(-74.0060)

    # Handle missing/invalid passenger count
    df["passenger_count"] = df["passenger_count"].fillna(1)
    df["passenger_count"] = df["passenger_count"].clip(0, 6)

    return df


# Preprocess data
print("Engineering features...")
train_processed = engineer_features(train_df)
test_processed = engineer_features(test_df)

# Filter extreme outliers
train_processed["fare_amount"] = train_processed["fare_amount"].clip(0.0, 1000.0)
train_processed = train_processed[train_processed["fare_amount"].between(0, 1000)]

# Define feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "hour",
    "day",
    "month",
    "dayofweek",
    "year",
    "distance",
    "latitude_diff",
    "longitude_diff",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
]

# Remove any columns that don't exist
feature_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if col in train_processed.columns]

# Sample smaller training set for faster training
np.random.seed(42)
n_samples = min(len(train_processed), 500000)
indices = np.random.choice(len(train_processed), n_samples, replace=False)
train_sampled = train_processed.iloc[indices].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Training data after sampling: {len(train_sampled)} rows")

# Hold-out validation split (80/20)
val_size = 0.2
val_idx = int(len(train_sampled) * (1 - val_size))
train_fold = train_sampled.iloc[:val_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
val_fold = train_sampled.iloc[val_idx:].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Training fold: {len(train_fold)}, Validation fold: {len(val_fold)}")

# Prepare feature matrix
X_train = train_fold[feature_cols].astype(np.float32)
y_train = train_fold["fare_amount"].astype(np.float64)
X_val = val_fold[feature_cols].astype(np.float32)
y_val = val_fold["fare_amount"].astype(np.float64)

# Test set features only
X_test = test_processed[feature_cols].astype(np.float32)

print(f"Train features shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"Validation features shape: {X_val.shape}")
print(f"Test features shape: {X_test.shape}")

# LightGBM parameters - optimized for speed
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "lambda_l1": 0.1,
    "lambda_l2": 0.1,
    "max_depth": 6,
    "num_iteration_burn_in": 10,
}

# Create datasets
train_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_dataset)

# Train model with early stopping
print("Training LightGBM model...")
num_boost_round = 500
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_dataset,
    num_boost_round=num_boost_round,
    valid_sets=[val_dataset],
    callbacks=[
        lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
    ],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)

# Calculate RMSE: sqrt(mean((y_true - y_pred)^2))
rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((y_val - val_pred) ** 2))
mae = np.mean(np.abs(y_val - val_pred))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")
print(f"Validation MAE: {mae:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Clip predictions to reasonable bounds
test_pred = np.clip(test_predictions, 0.01, 500.0)

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_df["key"], "fare_amount": test_pred})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission head:\n{submission.head()}")

# Verify submission format matches sample
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_sub.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns match: {set(submission.columns) == set(sample_sub.columns)}")

# Final stats
print(f"\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")
print(f"Time elapsed: {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print(f"Valid predictions: {len(submission)}")
